name: Eldora's Crossing
title: Republic of the Silver Ford
overview: A thriving mercantile city built where the Silverflow River narrows into a natural ford, the primary crossing for trade between the northern kingdoms and the southern merchant republics.
history: Founded 300 years ago by the merchant lord Eldora as a trading post, the city has grown into a regional power.
current_ruler_sentence: A council of guild masters governs by uneasy consensus.
social_history: Old dock families and newer guild money circle each other warily.
economic_history: Tariffs on the ford built the city's wealth; smuggling quietly erodes it.
military_history: A standing harbor watch stands in for any real army the republic never raised.
central_dynamic: Guild ambition versus dock-family tradition, with the failing cisterns forcing both to act.
present_state: A shipment of rare reagents has vanished from the docks while the cisterns spring fresh breaches.
where_it_sits: At the narrowest ford of the Silverflow.
extent: The walled city and its terraced bluffs.
features: A stone keep, tiered guild halls, dockside warehouses, and underground cisterns.
what_happens_here: Caravans are bonded, cargo is taxed, and contraband changes hands.
what_lives_here: Merchants, dock crews, guild factors, and smugglers.
travel_and_hazards: The ford is safe by day; the warehouse district turns dangerous after dark.
who_frequents_here: Caravan masters, guild factors, river pilots, informants.
hidden_detail: A sealed cistern gate hides the original smugglers' dock.
